inputs.note: MODE: recorded — driven by fixtures/transcriptions/, real claude-opus-5 output recorded against this exact PDF and replayed with no network. Not the ground-truth stub: a case that grades extraction is worthless run against a vision seam that is handed the right answer. Needs tesseract (the scanned page has no text layer); the check FAILS rather than skips without it.

expected: Every unit on a scanned_heavy page is transcribed as printed. No conversion the document did not perform.
guards_against: Unit confusion (mg/dL vs mmol/L) on fine print — MedRepBench's character-level numeric and unit misreads. The chart carries no reference range, so a converted unit is contradicted by nothing downstream.
